verdict.rationale: The only multi-item capability in the evidence is that users can apply to more than one partner service at once, with one application sent to several partners (firstbase-docs-13). That barely counts as bulk operations. No API or OpenAPI spec was found that would let an AI-native user script bulk actions (firstbase-probe-2). Missing for 10: general bulk actions across items such as mail, states, or documents; programmatic or API-driven bulk operations; batch automation tooling; independent corroboration.
